adminCatalog.title: Catalog
adminCatalog.copy: Manage live combo terms and sparse overrides for upstream Remnawave squads.
adminCatalog.noCombosHint: Create the first plan to open the catalog.
adminCatalog.squadsHint: Identity comes from live Remnawave squads; only non-default display and price values are stored locally.
adminCatalog.noSquadsHint: Refresh from Remnawave to configure optional access.
adminCatalog.hideDescription: The combo is hidden from new checkout. Existing and historical purchases keep their live reference, so later edits still affect them.

adminCatalogEditor.name: Name
adminCatalogEditor.trafficLimitHint: Use bytes or B, KB, MB, GB, or TB. It is saved as exact bytes.
adminCatalogEditor.trafficLimitInvalid: Enter bytes or a value such as 10 GB.
adminCatalogEditor.noSquads: Refresh Remnawave squads before assigning them.
adminCatalogEditor.liveTermsHint: Hiding blocks new checkout. Changes to this live record affect active, queued, and historical purchases.
